Variants are the factory versions swap vendors recommend: K24A2 (2004-2005 and 2006-2008 Acura TSX), the JDM K24A with the RBB head and 200 PS rating (CL9 Accord, CM2 Accord Wagon Type S, RB1 Odyssey Absolute), K24Z3 (2009-2014 TSX), K24Z7 (2012-2013 and 2014-2015 Civic Si) and the K24A1 (2002-2005 and 2006 CR-V, split at Honda's 2006 SAE J1349 Rev 8/04 re-rating), the usual donor block for K24-block/K20-head builds. Primary sources: American Honda press kits (acuranews.com and hondanews.com, one newsroom, so they count as one source family here), Honda Japan's own auto-archive spec sheets, Acura/Honda US brochures (auto-brochures.com) and the 2002 CR-V service manual (archive.org). Swap fitment comes from vendors: KPower Industries (RWD kits, adapters, pans), Hasport (FWD mounts and transmission families), Hybrid Racing, Humble Performance, TF-Works, XAT Racing and FischRacingTech. Weak spots: dry weight (a vendor's and an owner's forum figures), outline dimensions (a geometric estimate), the factory sump position (one builder's statement), and the rod and piston materials of the K24A-family engines.

bellhousing.note: One bolt pattern for the whole K20/K24 family (Honda K transaxles). Factory gearboxes are all transverse FWD transaxles (5- and 6-speed manuals and automatics; AWD CR-V/Element versions): RSX and 2002-2011 Civic Si; 2003-2007 Accord and 2004-2008 TSX; 2008-2013 Accord, 2009-2014 TSX and 2012-2015 Civic Si; CR-V/Element (Hasport). They differ in case mounting points, shifter linkage and speed sensors, not in the engine face (Hybrid Racing), and only the 2012-2015 Civic Si (K24Z7) 6-speed has a factory LSD among K24 gearboxes ('No K24 transmission was equipped with an LSD (Except the K24Z7*)'). RWD needs an adapter plate plus a matching flywheel: KPower makes them for the Mazda MX-5 NA/NB, NC and ND gearboxes, the Toyota/Subaru 86 gearbox and BMW Getrag 260, Getrag 5-speed, ZF 5-speed and ZF 6-speed (E30/E36/E46); XAT Racing, FischRacingTech and Autosports Engineering make K-series to Nissan CD009/CD00A (350Z/370Z) kits, and Collins Performance Technologies a K-series to Nissan KA24DE 5-speed (S13) kit. Speed Academy's K24A2 S14 240SX runs a BMW E46 ZF through the KMiata (KPower) plate. XAT's catalogue also lists Toyota W and R series gearboxes, but no K-series kit for them was opened. KPower's BMW kit comes in 13 or 15 degree clocking (15 = Honda's factory lean). The K24 flywheel uses Honda bolt 90011-RDB-000 (KPower).

variants.notes: RBB cylinder head (FFS TechNet). Balance-shaft oil pump in a steel pan. Drive-by-wire throttle, EGR on the intake manifold (Hybrid Racing). KPower's first choice for RWD swaps ('The K24A2 from the 2004-2008 TSX is the most potent K24 in stock form'); in swaps it makes 220-230 whp with a 50-degree VTC gear and bolt-ons (KPower). Wikipedia's 7,200 rpm rev limiter is a lead only, not used. 2006 hardware changes (Honda): intake valve 35 to 36 mm, more intake lift and duration at high rpm ('intake valve lift and opening duration were increased'), throttle body 60 to 64 mm, intake runner radius 70 to 80 mm, exhaust pipe 54 to 57.2 mm, crank balance weight optimized, connecting rods strengthened, ventilation holes between cylinders. The rating also moved to SAE J1349 (Rev 8/04): 'all Acura horsepower and torque specifications have been updated to reflect revised Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) J1349 (Rev 8/04) net calculations that went into affect in January of 2005' (Acura). So 200 hp/166 lb-ft (old procedure) became 205 hp/164 lb-ft; Honda does not split the change between hardware and procedure (torque fell despite the upgrades, which points at the procedure). Swappers value the 2006-2008 cams (Humble: '06-08 K24A2 is more desirable over earlier years due to camshaft design').
